## Interpretation

These player-only ratings adjust for the identities of teammates and opponents,
plus the toss and batting first. Selection into the XI is not random; favorable
conditions and selective appearances can still influence the coefficients.

See [methods and selection bias](methods.qmd#selection-and-match-difficulty),
[the ranking specification](format_rankings.qmd), and
[data and downloads](data.qmd). Scores are comparable within each table, not
between formats or genders. The window includes players who have since retired.
